title: Chipmunk — librarian, thief, dreamer
description: The chipmunk takes tickets, triages by π-budget, looks forward and plans backward. 11 tasks on the board. Mouth + skeleton smelted tonight.
note: Referenced by berry-campfire. The chipmunk steals fossils and reseeds them.

pi_set.note: stub 4/41 on the imaginary axis. frac(4×π) = 0.5664

crush: stolen from static, crushed, reseeded with π. the stub was the seed. the seed is now a plant.
